mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have fair conditions at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 70 degrees.

The City of Verona has announced that city buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 in observance of the upcoming holiday. Additionally, refuse and recycling collection scheduled for Thursday will be delayed until Friday, November 27.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music at Bailey's Run happening today. You can also catch live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.

In a noteworthy call from November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance, which resulted in the arrest of a 48-year-old Verona man for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's delicious flavor is Turtle Dove. The store is currently open but will be closing in 55 minutes, so there is still time to stop by for a treat before they close for the evening.
